author: Cleo Abram
description:
We’ve spent a lot of time looking out to the cosmos and asking “are we alone?” 

In the 1960’s physicist Freeman Dyson came up with a theory about what an alien civilization more advanced than ours might look like to give us a better idea of what we might want to look for. 

To learn more about what he thought we might find and the science-fiction sounding plots that may soon be reality… Subscribe! 

#science #aliens #technology #space
title: What Actually Is A Dyson Sphere?
